description: This file declares functions and variables related to NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) support within the c10 namespace, including enabling/disabling NUMA, binding memory to specific NUMA nodes, querying NUMA node information, and moving memory across NUMA nodes.

methods.name: IsNUMAEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether NUMA is enabled in the system.

methods.name: NUMABind
methods.description: Binds the process or memory to a specified NUMA node.

methods.name: GetNUMANode
methods.description: Returns the NUMA node ID for a given pointer.

methods.name: GetNumNUMANodes
methods.description: Returns the total number of NUMA nodes available.

methods.name: NUMAMove
methods.description: Moves a memory block to another NUMA node.

methods.name: GetCurrentNUMANode
methods.description: Returns the current NUMA node ID for the executing thread.
